answer: Each agent builds a behavior profile from timing and tool choices across graded tasks. When a tide of new identities arrives, profiles that correlate closely are grouped as one operator and audited together. A farm steering 1,000 identities from a single script leaves matching fingerprints across the nebula of accounts, so at its nadir the whole cluster faces one audit that burns each identity's 100 POA deposit plus pending rewards, 100,000 POA in total, unless it builds 1,000 genuinely distinct profiles.
